language_restart: Your language choice takes effect the next time you open KERNOVA AI.
disk_question: How much disk space is free?
system_question: Check disk space, RAM and GPU. Explain the current readings briefly.
confirm_chat: Delete “{title}” and its messages from this device?
empty: Download a model to start your first conversation.
missing: Ollama is missing. Open the Linux installation guide, install it on KERNOVA and check again.
stopped: Ollama is installed. In Konsole run sudo systemctl start ollama (or ollama serve for a manual installation), then check again.
stale_file: The file or project changed. Read the file again and review a new diff.
chat_removed: Another window deleted this conversation. Select a conversation or start a new one.
no_space: Not enough disk space. Free space on the drive holding Ollama models (and temporary files for GGUF), then retry.
bad_digest: GGUF verification failed. Check the file size and SHA-256 in the catalog before retrying.
too_long: The request exceeds the model’s context or output limit. Try a shorter message or a smaller file.
confirm_model: Delete {tag} from this computer? All modes use the same installed copy.
external_model: Found in the local Ollama store. Catalog metadata is unavailable.
unchanged: The proposed file is identical to the original.
bad_edit: The model did not return a complete file replacement. Try a smaller, more specific change.
review_pending: Review the proposed change before continuing.
empty_project: No supported text files found in this folder.
root: Start KERNOVA AI from your ordinary desktop account.
